coverage.rule: A value from a row whose coverage is under 50% is withheld: null, with a reason next to it.

provenance.definition: Pipeline runs, feed polls, duplicates and quarantine
sql: with t as (select cast(scheduled_at at time zone 'America/New_York' as date) as d, * from read_parquet('/Users/akshay/projects/headway/tests/fixtures/gold_snapshot/gold/agg_pipeline_health.parquet')) select strftime(d, '%Y-%m-%d') as date, count(*) as runs, sum(vehicle_polls_ok) as vehicle_polls_ok, sum(vehicle_polls_error) as vehicle_polls_error, sum(duplicate_delivery_count) as duplicate_deliveries, sum(quarantine_total) as quarantined_records, count(*) filter (where trip_updates_status <> 'ok') as trip_update_failures from t where d > (select max(d) from t) - 7 group by d order by d limit 501
